correctness.rationale: The star Gramian follows because distinct leaf rows e_i are orthogonal and each meets scaled center sqrt(w/m)1. Under exact Algorithm 3 update, selecting a leaf removes it and re-enables center; selecting center resets all leaves. From post-center S=all leaves, a successful episode selects all m leaves before center with p_G=prod_{r=1}^{m-1}r/(r+w). Renewal and episode-length tail probabilities give E T_G=C(m+w,m-1)+C(m+w-1,m-1)-1. IID ordinary RK draws center probability w/(m+w); success p_R=prod_{r=1}^m r/(r+w), with E center count 1/p_R-1; Wald yields E T_R=(m+w)/w(1/p_R-1). Gamma-ratio asymptotics yield ratio (w+1)/w for fixed w>0. A full leaf sweep without intervening center sets all leaf coordinates exactly because leaves are orthogonal; it is only a sufficient certificate, NOT the first actual solution hitting. Independent rational state recurrences agreed for 40 (m,w) pairs m2..9 and weights 1/4,2/3,1,3/2,4.

originality.rationale: The IID reset-coupon gamma baseline is already published in Resultary and must NOT be claimed novel. The distinct GSSRK star without replacement leaves has a state-dependent center hazard absent from that baseline or the Kaczmarz primary paper. Only the exact structural selectable-selector certificate, its w dependence and differential asymptotic remain original best of knowledge.
